source: Package names, prices and inclusions mirror the publicly listed MyServicePro Web Studio catalogue at https://www.myservicepro.co.za/get-a-website.html. Lula ProVeri ships the same promise (preview before you pay) plus ProVeri-specific upgrades, flagged with `proveriUpgrade`.
promise: Preview first, pay after. We build your live interactive preview before you pay a cent.

packages.name: Digital Storefront
packages.blurb: A clean, fast, professional online home without ongoing database hosting fees.
includes: Sleek single-page, mobile-first website
Standard WhatsApp direct click-to-chat
Google Search & Maps visibility setup
Up to 3 sections, gallery setup for up to 10 photos
.co.za domain registration + zero monthly hosting fees

breakdown.detail: Direct click-to-chat button so visitors can message you immediately.
.co.za registration with zero monthly hosting fees.
Initial setup of up to 10 of your project photos.

packages.proveriUpgrade: Auto-generated from your verified ProVeri profile: reviews, trust badge, availability and live job history are data-bound, so the site never goes stale.

packages.name: Website-as-a-Service
packages.blurb: A fully managed, professional website without the high upfront cost. We handle hosting, updates and maintenance every month.
includes: Custom mobile storefront with low upfront fee
Fast cloud hosting + 24/7 security monitoring included
Monthly content updates — just WhatsApp us your changes
Cancel anytime with 20 business days' notice
packages.proveriUpgrade: Monthly report includes your ProVeri trust score, review velocity and jobs won from the site — so you can see exactly what the R450 buys.

packages.name: Business Growth Storefront
packages.blurb: For businesses that need dedicated pages for different services, client testimonials and online deposit payments.
includes: 3–5 page custom responsive website
PayFast / Yoco online payments & deposit collection
Smart WhatsApp quote request forms
12 months technical support & maintenance included
Local search & Google Maps optimisation
packages.proveriUpgrade: Embedded ProVeri booking widget: visitors can post a job and pay into escrow without leaving your site. You keep your brand, we keep the money safe.

packages.name: Premium E-Commerce
packages.blurb: Sell physical or digital goods online 24/7 with direct settlement into your South African bank account.
includes: Full online store / custom shopping catalogue
PayFast / Yoco / Ozow secure checkout integration
Inventory management & order notifications
Premium mobile UI/UX design optimised for checkout conversions
packages.proveriUpgrade: Optional TradeSafe escrow on high-value orders so customers can pay in confidence and you can ship without chargeback fear.

packages.name: "Page 3" Website Rescue
packages.audience: Glitchy, slow or outdated existing sites
packages.blurb: Instead of rebuilding from zero at agency rates, we rescue your existing content and assets and port them to a fast, modern setup.
includes: Full technical diagnostic of your current site
Fix broken mobile views, broken buttons & layout glitches
Speed overhaul & modern redesign
Move to fast, zero-monthly-fee cloud architecture
packages.proveriUpgrade: Diagnostic report is machine-generated and hash-sealed — you own the audit even if you never buy the rescue.

packages.name: Student & Individual Portfolio
packages.blurb: A single-page portfolio or digital CV with a shareable link for WhatsApp and LinkedIn.
includes: Single-page portfolio website / digital CV
Mobile-optimised shareable link for WhatsApp & LinkedIn
Contact form + LinkedIn/social links
Zero monthly server fees
packages.proveriUpgrade: Free tier: every verified ProVeri pro already gets an auto-generated profile microsite at no cost. Pay only if you want the custom portfolio treatment.

growthServices.name: Get Recommended on Google
how: Google Business Profile setup or complete audit of your existing listing
Verified service areas across your target suburbs and towns
Search-optimised service categories and keywords so Google matches you with local searches
High-resolution photo uploads with location tags to build instant customer trust
Review-request system to turn happy past clients into 5-star Google reviews
growthServices.honestBoundary: Google local ranking depends on relevance, distance and authentic customer reviews. We maximise your profile's authority so Google recommends you over unverified competitors.
growthServices.proveriUpgrade: Review requests are sent only after an escrow-released job — so every Google review you earn is backed by a real, paid, completed booking.

growthServices.name: Automate Your WhatsApp
how: Professional Business Profile with opening hours, business address & website link
In-app service and product catalogue with photos, descriptions and starting prices
24/7 automated greeting and after-hours away message for instant customer responses
5 quick-reply shortcuts (send full price list, bank details or quotes in 1 tap)
Direct click-to-chat links for your Facebook, Instagram and TikTok bios
growthServices.honestBoundary: Configured directly on your phone using official WhatsApp Business app tools (no monthly software bills). Advanced automated AI bots or custom API connections are quoted separately.
growthServices.proveriUpgrade: Quick-reply template that turns a WhatsApp enquiry into a ProVeri job link — keeps the money inside escrow instead of losing it to a cash deal.

growthServices.name: Get Customer Leads
growthServices.audience: Contractors · Trades · Salons looking for calls
how: Targeted local ads on Google Search and Meta (Facebook/Instagram radius targeting)
High-intent setup routing incoming homeowner enquiries into your WhatsApp or phone calls
Custom ad creative banners and persuasive copy written for your trade
Live conversion tracking and a weekly performance report
growthServices.honestBoundary: You fund your ad budget directly on Google/Meta (we recommend starting from R50–R100/day). We don't sell cold recycled phone lists — we build the live advertising machine that brings fresh, paying enquiries to your phone.
growthServices.proveriUpgrade: Ad creative auto-features your live ProVeri trust badge and star rating, which measurably lifts click-through versus unverified competitors.

growthServices.name: Professional Posters & Brand Kit
how: 4 high-definition custom branded promotional posters (WhatsApp status 1080x1920 & feed square 1080x1080)
1 branded digital price list / service menu card with your contact and banking details
Clean typography touch-up or modern logo refinement
Ready-to-copy promotional captions with local hashtags + 1 revision round included
growthServices.honestBoundary: Defined graphics package (client supplies core photos and text). Ongoing monthly content creation is quoted separately.
growthServices.proveriUpgrade: Banking details on the price-list card are replaced by your ProVeri payment link — customers pay into escrow, not into a personal account.

freeProVeriMicrosite.name: Your ProVeri Profile Microsite (free)
freeProVeriMicrosite.blurb: Generated automatically the moment your verification passes. Live-data bound, so it never goes stale.
includes: Your own public URL: lulaproveri.co.za/p/<your-slug>
Live trust badge and 0–100 ProVeri score
Only reviews from completed, escrow-protected jobs
Live availability and instant-book button
Portfolio gallery from your proof-of-work evidence
WhatsApp click-to-chat and one-tap job request
Printable QR code for your bakkie, toolbox or till slip
